messages.author: 7a4f623cb1a7f23d
messages.subject: Do we need our own server to run a shiny app on a web link?
parts:
Hi,

I am confused with shiny server services - will my shiny-app run on R server or this will run on my own server?
Actually I want to create a web link for my app which should be accessible from anywhere at anytime.

Thanks

messages.author: 43604b83b60f48e6
messages.subject: Re: Do we need our own server to run a shiny app on a web link?
parts:
afaik you need a shiny server to share a link, especially as a rstudio launched shiny app isnt persistent. Shiny server isnt trivial to set up (and only on OSX/linux - no windows) however if you're willing to & get docker toolbox up & running it's very rewarding in itself, and you can just download a shiny server container from here: 
https://hub.docker.com/r/quantumobject/docker-shiny/
